notes: ENX Association governs TISAX (Trusted Information Security Assessment Exchange), the European automotive industry's mutual-recognition assessment and exchange mechanism for supplier information security audits based on the VDA/ENX ISA (Information Security Assessment) catalog.

match_nodes.description: TISAX — Trusted Information Security Assessment Exchange assessment and mutual-recognition methodology

data.description: Automotive industry conformity assessment and exchange methodology governed by ENX Association on behalf of VDA. Audits suppliers against the ENX/VDA ISA catalog at three Assessment Levels (AL1 self-assessment, AL2 plausibility check, AL3 on-site audit) and issues TISAX labels shared across participants.
data.notes: TISAX is the assessment and certification exchange methodology; the underlying control catalog is ISA (see secid:control/enx.com/isa).

cross_references.note: TISAX assessments evaluate conformity against the ENX/VDA Information Security Assessment (ISA) catalog.
